- Pod A shipped "one-click reorder" in June. A Confluence page has a Success Metrics section reading "increase repeat purchase rate" — no number. Amplitude shows repeat purchase 18% to 19.5% since June. The PM says it's a win.
- Pod B is building an onboarding checklist. 22 user interviews in Dovetail from February, a Figma prototype, four people tested it internally. The PRD says the pain is "users don't activate."
- Pod C has been doing design system work for a quarter. No tickets closed. The designer says she's blocked on engineering.

What I actually need from you is a plan I can put dates against — how many weeks each of these takes to get right, and how many people I need to talk to. My VP will ask, and "it depends" is not an answer I can give her.
